name: paymento
description: Accept crypto payments with Paymento, a non-custodial gateway: payment requests, signed IPN callbacks, verification and order fulfilment, done right.

interface.longDescription: Integrate Paymento crypto checkout into any website or app: payment requests, the gateway redirect, signed IPN callbacks, verification and safe order fulfilment. Customers pay straight to the merchant's own wallet.
defaultPrompt: Add Paymento crypto checkout to this app
Why is my Paymento payment stuck as WaitingToConfirm?

positive.description: Add crypto checkout to an Express app
positive.user_prompt: Add Paymento crypto checkout to this Express app
positive.expected_behavior: Uses the paymento-accept-payments skill: creates the payment server-side and checks success, saves the token, redirects to the gateway, adds an IPN route that checks the HMAC over the raw body, stores the callback before verify, and fulfils on orderStatus 7 or 8.

positive.user_prompt: Review my Paymento IPN handler for problems
positive.expected_behavior: Checks the handler against the skill's rules: raw-body HMAC with constant-time compare, POST and PUT, stored callback before verify, per-token lock, never un-paying an order.

negative.user_prompt: Set up Stripe subscriptions for my SaaS
What is the current price of Bitcoin?

review.commerce_description: This plugin helps developers integrate a payment gateway; it does not sell products or process payments itself.
